canonical.title: Burgers, Lipstick & Underwear
canonical.subtitle: What Strange Indicators Really Tell Us About the Economy
canonical.author: Anton Biletskyi-Volokh
canonical.summary: A curious, skeptical tour of the strange indicators people use to understand prices, purchasing power, economic stress, risk, and technological progress.
canonical.short_description: A sharp, entertaining guide to the strange indicators people use to make the economy readable—from Big Macs and iPhone work-hours to lipstick, freight rates, pollution equivalents, and AI benchmarks.
